The shared spinner in `src/ui/spinner.tsx` advances one frame per interval callback, so event-loop delays during busy work make the animation fall behind and slow down cumulatively. Derive the shared frame index from a monotonic elapsed-time clock instead of counting callbacks, so that after a delayed callback the spinner catches up to the frame that corresponds to the elapsed time, and tick boundaries are exact.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/ui/spinner.test.ts`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/ui/spinner.test.ts` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
